description: Several large Duplo-style blocks in white, yellow, green, blue, and red are stacked together on the blue fabric in front of you. The left hand comes in from the left while the right hand reaches in from the right, and they grasp the stack as a two-hand object; the right hand pulls a small red piece free, then lifts and separates additional pieces as the left hand steadies the remaining blocks. The blocks are fully disassembled and spread out, with the right hand setting the red piece down to the right and the left hand sliding the blue base leftward.
